designationHistory.indexText: Established Sept. 23, 1937, as the Lake Thibadeau Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7713, signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt.

review.note: Wrong day: EO 7713 is dated Sept. 23, 1937, not Sept. 28. Signer was a parsing fragment.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Lake Thibadeau National Wildlife Refuge was established on September 28, 1937 by Executive Order No. 7713 as "a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife." Our History The history of Lake Thibadeau National Wildlife Refuge is tied to the Emergency Relief Act and the Works Progress Administration program.
